story.iWant: the system to automatically sync new game data on a schedule
story.soThat: my analytics stay up-to-date without manual intervention

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** I have completed an initial import **When** new games are played on gomafia.pro **Then** the system: - Automatically detects new games (checks last sync timestamp) - Runs scheduled sync job (configurable: daily, hourly, or every N hours) - Imports only new games since last sync (incremental import) - Updates existing games if data changed on gomafia.pro - Sends notification (optional) when sync completes - Logs sync results (games imported, errors encountered)
2. **And** scheduled sync: - Runs in background without blocking user requests - Respects rate limits on gomafia.pro - Handles scheduled sync failures gracefully (retry on next schedule) - Can be enabled/disabled per user in preferences

docs.doc: System can synchronize data automatically on a scheduled basis (FR8). Users can manually trigger data import/synchronization (FR9). System validates imported data quality with ≥98% accuracy threshold (FR10).

Playwright for web scraping, Zod for data validation, Rate limiting: 2-second delays (30 req/min), Batch processing: 100 records per batch, Checkpoint system: Resume capability, Advisory locks: Prevent concurrent imports, Failed Scraping Points Storage: SkippedEntity model stores failed scraping operations.
TanStack Query for server state (sync status polling). Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts. Stale time: 5 minutes, GC time: 10 minutes, Retry: 3 attempts, Background refetching enabled.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.

Goal: System can reliably import and synchronize game data from gomafia.pro with quality validation. User Value: Users' game data is available in the platform. Essential foundation for all analytics features. FRs Covered: FR7-FR15.

Cron job or scheduled task (Vercel Cron, or external scheduler). Incremental sync logic: compare last_sync_at timestamp with game dates. Sync job API endpoint: POST /api/gomafia-sync/scheduled. Configuration: store sync preferences in user preferences table.

Import Infrastructure Available: ImportOrchestrator class exists with importHistoricalData() method. Can extend with syncIncremental() method for scheduled syncs. Use existing phase-based import pattern (Clubs → Players → Tournaments → Games → Statistics → Judges).
Rate Limiting: Existing RateLimiter class enforces 2-second delays (2000ms) between requests. Must use same rate limiting for scheduled syncs to respect gomafia.pro servers.
Progress Tracking: CheckpointManager and sync_status table exist for tracking import progress. Can reuse for scheduled sync status tracking.
Error Handling: SkippedEntitiesManager exists for handling failed scraping operations. Use same error handling patterns for scheduled syncs.
Concurrent Import Prevention: AdvisoryLock exists with user-specific locks. Scheduled sync should check for active imports before starting to prevent conflicts.

constraints.constraint: Architecture Pattern: Clean Architecture + Hexagonal Architecture. Domain layer must remain framework-independent.
Rate Limiting: Must enforce 2-second delays between requests (30 req/min max) to respect gomafia.pro servers. Use existing RateLimiter class.
Concurrent Import Prevention: Must check for active imports using AdvisoryLock before starting scheduled sync to prevent conflicts.
Error Handling: Use existing SkippedEntitiesManager patterns for failed scraping operations. Log errors to sync_logs table.
Background Processing: Scheduled sync must run in background without blocking user requests. Use Next.js API route with async processing.
State Management: Use TanStack Query for server state (sync status polling). Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts.
Responsive Design: Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px.
Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.
Component Library: Use ShadCN/UI components (Switch, Select, Card, Toast) from src/components/ui/.
Testing: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage. TDD approach. Unit tests for sync logic, integration tests for scheduled sync flow, E2E tests for complete sync journey.
API Endpoint Pattern: Follow pattern in src/app/api/gomafia-sync/ directory. Scheduled sync endpoint should be in src/app/api/gomafia-sync/scheduled/ directory.
Database: Use Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL. Add sync preferences fields to User model: syncEnabled (boolean, default: false), syncSchedule (string), lastSyncAt (DateTime, nullable).
Cron Configuration: Use Vercel Cron for scheduled tasks. Configure via vercel.json or Vercel Cron API. Default schedule: daily at midnight UTC, configurable via environment variable.

interface.name: POST /api/gomafia-sync/scheduled
interface.signature: POST /api/gomafia-sync/scheduled - Processes scheduled sync for all users with sync enabled. Returns sync summary (users processed, games imported, errors).

interface.name: GET /api/gomafia-sync/status
interface.signature: GET /api/gomafia-sync/status - Returns sync status for authenticated user (last sync timestamp, sync enabled status, sync schedule, sync logs).

interface.name: ImportOrchestrator.syncIncremental()
interface.signature: syncIncremental(userId: string, lastSyncAt: Date): Promise<SyncResult> - Incremental sync method to be added to ImportOrchestrator class. Compares lastSyncAt with game dates, imports only new games, updates existing games if data changed.

interface.name: User.syncEnabled
interface.signature: syncEnabled: boolean (default: false) - User preference to enable/disable automatic sync.

interface.name: User.syncSchedule
interface.signature: syncSchedule: string - User preference for sync schedule (e.g., 'daily', 'hourly', '0 0 * * *' cron expression).

interface.name: User.lastSyncAt
interface.signature: lastSyncAt: DateTime | null - Tracks last successful sync timestamp for incremental sync logic.

tests.standards: Testing standards require 80% coverage minimum, TDD approach. Unit tests for sync logic, orchestrator methods; integration tests for scheduled sync flow; E2E tests for user journey (enable sync → scheduled sync runs → status updates); accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Test location: tests/unit/, tests/integration/, tests/e2e/. Use Vitest for unit/integration tests, Playwright for E2E tests.
tests.locations: tests/unit/ - Unit tests for sync logic and orchestrator methods tests/integration/ - Integration tests for scheduled sync flow tests/e2e/ - E2E tests for complete sync journey tests/components/ - Component tests for sync preferences UI

ideas.test: Test complete scheduled sync flow: cron triggers → scheduled sync endpoint → incremental import → status update → logging. Verify games imported, errors handled, status updated correctly.
Test scheduled sync with multiple users: some with sync enabled, some disabled. Verify only enabled users are processed.
Test scheduled sync failure handling and retry: simulate failure, verify retry on next schedule, verify graceful error handling.
Test syncIncremental() method: verify incremental import logic compares lastSyncAt with game dates, imports only new games, updates existing games if data changed.
Test rate limiting for scheduled sync: verify 2-second delays enforced, verify rate limiting works across multiple users.
Test background processing: verify scheduled sync doesn't block user requests, verify sync completes in background.
Test sync preferences UI: user enables sync → saves preferences → scheduled sync runs → status updates. Verify UI reflects saved preferences, verify page is accessible.
Test sync notification system: verify notifications sent when sync completes, verify notifications respect user preferences, verify notification content is accurate.
Test sync preferences page accessibility: verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance using @axe-core/playwright, verify keyboard navigation, verify screen reader compatibility.
